premises.text: Teams are forced to use too many tools to get their work done, leading to data silos and disconnection.
premises.evidence_span: these days, teams are forced to use way too many tools to get their work done, tools that promise to streamline our workflows, improve our team collaboration, and bring our teams together.

premises.text: Data that lives in silos kills productivity and frustrates teams.
premises.evidence_span: Data that lives in silos kills productivity, and it frustrates teams.

premises.text: Existing all-in-one workspaces have a higher barrier of entry and cannot satisfy all team workflows.
premises.evidence_span: All-in-one workspaces like Zendesk and Notion, they come with a higher barrier of entry. It's going to take time for your team to learn how to use this platform.

premises.text: Data integrators have limited interactivity and can create noise in data management.
premises.evidence_span: the main issue here is the level of interactivity between your data is limited. One-way synchronization does little to move your agenda forward, and adding layers of integrations just makes your data more noisy.

premises.text: Jamilius integrates with email to simplify teamwork and allows users to choose their preferred workspace.
premises.evidence_span: Jamilius starts by integrating with the most natural workspace of teams, and that's your email inbox.

premises.text: Jamilius turns email conversations into flexible channels that can be translated into other forms of communication.
premises.evidence_span: We take your email conversations and turn them into flexible channels, channels that can then be translated into other forms of communication.

premises.text: Jamilius allows users to monitor and manage tasks without leaving their inbox.
premises.evidence_span: Yoda is able to take that email, turn it into a task card, and add it to his Trello-like Kanban board. This is all without leaving his inbox.

premises.text: Jamilius has significant growth potential in a large market.
premises.evidence_span: we operate in a space that has 1.5 billion Gmail users and 6 million companies that use G Suite.

value.text: Jamilius simplifies teamwork and improves collaboration across different platforms.
value.evidence_span: our team in Geneva is ultra passionate about empowering teams and improving collaboration.

notes: Traction metrics and Y Combinator mention are excluded as they do not support premises.
